title: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo
slides: Can a 32MB model beat your speech assistant?
Underdog built it to run on tiny devices
But most tiny models fail on real accents
Your next earbuds may not need the cloud
Test one hard audio clip against it today
thread_text:
32MB vs Your Assistant

A team just squeezed a speech model into less memory than a single photo. It runs on-device, no cloud round trip.

Built for Tiny Devices

The model fits on earbuds and watches, not just phones. That means offline voice control without a server.

Tiny Models Fail Accents

Most compact models break on real-world accents and noisy rooms. This one claims to handle them, but claims are cheap.

No Cloud in Your Earbuds

If it works, your next earbuds could process speech locally. No latency, no data leaving your head.

Test It on One Clip

Grab a hard audio clip with your accent and run it against this model today. If it fails, you know before the marketing does.
